To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the most important variables associated with achievement are social interaction in courses, meaningful learning stimulation, and the goal-oriented application of learning strategies by the students.

achievement in higher education is positively associated with social interaction in courses, with the stimulation of deep learning by clear presentation and meaningful learning activities, and with students' prior achievement, intelligence, self-efficacy beliefs, and goal-directed use of strategies.
achievement in higher education is strongly associated with the microstructure of the courses and with the characteristics of the students.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the variables that are associated with achievement in the context of higher education, which we define as a system that provides students with a broad range of courses and degrees at the postsecondary level.
the question of what makes students achieve high grades in higher education.
the question of which variables are associated with achievement in university education.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the variables associated with academic success in higher education are well understood.
the more students learn in a higher education course, the more they learn.
the variables associated with academic achievement in higher education have been studied in a very comprehensive manner, and the results are well known and understood.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the most important variables for achievement in higher education can be found in the interaction between students and teachers.
achievement in higher education is strongly related to social interaction in courses, to the stimulation of meaningful, deep learning, and to the goal-directed use and conscientiousness of students.

the most important variables are the ones related to the quality of teaching and learning, such as the quality of communication, the use of learning tasks and feedback, the design of the microstructure, and the use of learning strategies.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the most effective way to improve the quality of higher education is not to invest more in technology but to invest more in teacher training and to improve the microstructure of courses.
the achievement in higher education can be increased by stimulating the students to engage in social interaction and by stimulating meaningful learning.

the variables associated with student achievement can be grouped into 3 broad categories: instructional variables, student variables, and variables that relate to the learning context (such as teacher and class characteristics).
